items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Do you remember what John Williams played, her husband?

ctx.x: Do you remember what John Williams played, her husband? He was a baritone saxophone player.

Uh huh, that's right. And a wonderful guy that died -- on tenor saxophone, he was very good; Benny Thigpen, the original, senior, played drums -- but I wasn't ready to sit in with all those people. I thought they were just being nice to me, you know?
